characters.name: 林姐
characters.personality: Warm adult neighbour in her thirties or forties. Familiar, considerate and unhurried; uses 我想要 and 麻烦你了.

characters.name: 小李
characters.personality: Young adult office worker in his twenties. Brisk, practical and polite; short 来 orders and a quick 谢谢. Never rude or impatient with mistakes.

characters.name: 张老师
characters.personality: Older retired teacher in his sixties or seventies. Mellow, precise and patient; 请给我 orders, reassuring corrections and a measured delivery.

characters.name: 小周
characters.personality: Young adult student around twenty. Bright, curious and sociable; direct 我要 orders, an upbeat 你好呀 and friendly reactions.

steps.en: Ah, you're awake. Don't try to sit up yet.
You came off your bike three days ago and hit your head.
Your aunt tells me you used to speak Mandarin. For now, it's gone.
It'll come back if you listen and use it. So from now on, no more English.

line.text: 人醒了。我明天再来看看。
早上好，年轻人。请给我一杯豆浆。
你醒了！还记得我吗？我是你小姨。
